caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica is rarely a matter of predictable singletrack. It is a constant negotiation with damp clay, steep mountain passes, and the thick air of our high-altitude forests. I design our routes to embrace this raw character, testing every climb myself to find the perfect balance between challenge and pure flow. Have you ever ridden through a cloud forest?
